# `TargetOutcome`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Runner\TargetOutcome`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Runner/TargetOutcome.php#L12) — **Version:** working tree

What the search did for one [`Target`](/api/classes/Target) label.

## Constructor

```php
__construct(
    string $label,
    \Runner\TargetDirection $direction,
    ?float $best,
    int $improvements,
    int $recalled = 0,
)
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$label` | `string` | *required* | The label as reported to `Target::maximize()`/`minimize()`. |
| `$direction` | [`Runner\TargetDirection`](/api/classes/Runner/TargetDirection) | *required* | Which way the label was pushed. |
| `$best` | `?float` | *required* | The best score any passing run reached, in that direction; null when no run reported the label. |
| `$improvements` | `int` | *required* | How many times the best improved, across the random and the search phase — each one was a [`Event\TargetImproved`](/api/classes/Event/TargetImproved). |
| `$recalled` | `int` | `0` | How many stored best inputs the search started from ([`Runner\SearchCorpus`](/api/classes/Runner/SearchCorpus)). |
